author: scwbs
reason: Add environment diagnostics and --fix support to scwbs doctor (Issue #98)

node.name: Doctor environment diagnostics
acceptanceCriteria: doctor detects Node.js / npm versions, root node_modules, wjs/node_modules, git, contracts/registry.yaml, contracts/wbs/project.wbs.json, and wjs/schema/wbs-json.schema.json presence
doctor reports suggested fix commands for each detected FAIL
doctor --fix runs only safe repairs (npm install, npm install --prefix wjs) and refuses destructive operations
README documents doctor usage including the --fix flag
